name: AI Level Loader
description: Load and preview AI-generated Geometry Dash levels from JSON with full trigger support (Move, Color, Pulse, Alpha, Rotate, Shake, Toggle, Spawn).

json-path.name: JSON File Path
json-path.description: Path to the level JSON file to load on your device.

paste-to-clipboard.name: Also Copy to Clipboard
paste-to-clipboard.description: Automatically copies the generated GD objects to clipboard so you can paste anywhere in the editor.
